data.long_meaning: Biri is a Hindu name that originates from the Sanskrit and Hindi languages. It is derived from the name of the goddess of fertility and water, Bhirani. The name Biri signifies the power and abundance of nature, particularly in the areas of growth and nourishment. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Biri carries the meaning “Goddess of Fertility and Water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Biri usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
